description: URI-keyed manual overrides for places where the upstream gazetteer (TGN, Pleiades, Wikidata) returned no coordinates. Each entry produces a ResolvedPlace with source='manual'. Coordinates are reviewable best-effort centroids — edit freely. Add a 'note' field to record rationale.
